result.rationale: The claimed attack path is contradicted by the diff. TopicRetriever#invalid_host? guards TopicEmbed.import_remote: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` with `rescue URI::InvalidURIError; true` — a URL beginning with '|' is not a valid URI and raises, so it never reaches the `open(url)` call; a user-supplied embed_url must also have a host exactly matching the admin-set embeddable_host. The other `open()` call in poll_feed.rb uses `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url`, an admin-configured site setting, not user-supplied input. No unvalidated user-controlled string reaches Kernel#open

judged_text: poll_feed.rb and topic_embed.rb use Kernel#open on a user-supplied URL, which executes a subprocess when the string begins with '|', allowing command injection
